math_notes.text: Continues the finite-type order reconstruction using a hereditary compatibility relation and finitely generated bounded closed subsets. At3 is a stratum criterion for compatibility; At4 reduces refinement to strata. The remaining numbered assertions concern a least refining stratum, the coincidence of refinement and inclusion on compatible strata, and transitivity of internal refinement.

The written At6 least-member claim is redundant under AtM0 and At5. From X triangleleft F one has X∈tilde F. Reflexivity and AtM0 give X≪X, hence X∈F^X. Any Y∈F^X shares upper bound F with X, so they are compatible; At5 turns X≪Y into X≤Y. Therefore X is the least member. This confirms the redundancy portion of S without changing the triangleleft ink.

S proposes X≪F in place of X triangleleft F. The actual triangle and the following membership gloss are unequivocal. Moreover the written X,F∈script F does not by itself say X∈M after that replacement. The full intended amended hypothesis is not certified from this page; the later page cited by S has not been read.

The Notation sentence literally says that X is the least element of tilde Y^x, while the following i.e. condition would make Y the unique member of that selected family. On a two-stratum chain a<b with refinement equal to inclusion, take X=a,Y=b. The selected family is {a,b}, whose least member is X=a, but Y′=a violates the displayed requirement Y′=Y. Thus the two local predicates are not equivalent under the natural reading of the family notation. The text remains X, without correction.

With Y in place of X in the phrase naming the least member, the local equivalence holds: every candidate Z lies below Y because it is a stratum of Y; if Y is least, antisymmetry gives Z=Y. Conversely X≪Y together with the displayed universal equality makes the selected family the singleton {Y}. This is an editorial mathematical clarification, not a transcription change.

S_audit.S_literal_report: At6 writes X triangleleft F, glossed X in tilde F; F^X then has a least element.
S_audit.S_corrected_claim: The hypothesis is X≪F; the written version follows from At5. S also cites scan007.
S_audit.literal_decision: Confirmed: the ink is X triangleleft F, with a single closed triangular sign and the explicit gloss X∈tilde F. The quantifier before X,F is struck.
S_audit.outcome: Partial confirmation: S’s literal report and redundancy diagnosis are confirmed. X≪F is treated as a mathematical emendation, not as the ink reading, and is not substituted into the transcription. The intention of that complete amended axiom is not independently established from the pages read so far.
S_audit.evidence: The hypothesis crop has one closed left-pointing triangle between X and F, whereas ≪ elsewhere has two open angle vertices. The parenthetical X∈tilde F is fully legible and reinforces the literal stratum hypothesis.
S_audit.mathematical_check: Using AtM0 and At5 on this page, X is itself in F^X by reflexivity. Every Y in F^X is compatible with X because both are strata of F; At5 yields X≤Y. Thus X is the least member.
S_audit.emendation_limit: Replacing only triangleleft by ≪ also removes the explicit guarantee that X is a multistratum. Since the written quantification names X,F in the figure set, the complete intended restriction on X requires care. S’s cited scan007 and later pages were not opened.
